literal: Pleasure is an ocean; but love, when that afflicts, the pain is greater than that.
translation: The pleasure of love is as vast as an ocean; but when that same love afflicts, its pain is far greater than the ocean.
modern: காமத்தின் இன்பம் கடல் போன்றது; ஆனால், அக்காமுற்ற நெஞ்சம் துன்புறுத்தும்போது, அதன் துன்பம் அக்கடலை விடப் பெரியதாகும்.
explanation: The heroine compares the dual experiences of love to the vastness of an ocean. She notes that the joy of love is as boundless as the sea. However, when love begins to torment her due to separation, the resulting grief becomes even larger than that immense ocean. The contrast highlights how the intensity of suffering in love can easily overwhelm even its greatest pleasures.
